scope.pairing: same six scene IDs; raw SHA-256 checked against frozen score

definitions.spectral_domain: Only position-error and task-attitude-error sequences were transformed; neither wind nor command/actuator signals were transformed. The 2-5 Hz band labels error frequency, not wind or control frequency.
definitions.spectral_estimator: One-sided rectangular-window DFT, no taper and no de-meaning; |rFFT|^2/N^2 with positive-frequency doubling. DC is retained. Reporting bins are descriptive.
definitions.position_error: state[:,0:3] - frozen reference.position; position-axis squared energies sum to frozen Q_m^2 per scene.
definitions.task_SO3_error: R_error = R_task^-1 R_actual, matching frozen SO(3) scorer; primary signed error vector is Rotation.as_rotvec() in task/reference coordinates. Its per-sample squared norm equals the frozen geodesic angle squared.
definitions.axis_contributions: Position axes x/y/z and signed task-frame Rotation-log axes x/y/z. The three rotation-log component energies add exactly to SO(3) squared error at every frequency.
definitions.aggregation: Scene-equal macro mean of each band energy over six HF scenes; pairwise differences use the same scene on both methods.
definitions.interpretation_scope: Descriptive HF6 frequency decomposition only; no causal inference and no generalization outside this cohort.
